summary: A whole month calendar screen from data: the month and year, weekday initials, a grid of 4 to 6 weeks with today marked, and the selected day's agenda. Compact cells (a phone) carry up to three coloured dots per day, large cells (a tablet or desktop) the events' titles as chips with "+N more"; a tap on a day selects it and lists its events. Stacked when portrait, the agenda a side panel from 600 dp wide in landscape. The month is a fixed year and month, or the current one from the clock.

days.doc: Dated events, one object per day that has any: {"day": 12, "events": [{"time": "09:30", "end": "10:15", "title": "Dentist", "subtitle": "Dr Patel, Elm St", "color": "@colors.success"}]}. day is the day of the shown month (1 to 31); events in the order they happen, all fields but title optional (no time: "All day"). Give each day once

weekly.doc: Events that repeat every week, by weekday: {"weekday": 0, "events": [...]}, 0 = Monday to 6 = Sunday, events as in days. Shown on every such day of whatever month is shown: honest with the real month (a class timetable, opening hours)

year.doc: With month: show this month (2026). Omit both for the current month, from the clock

month.doc: With year: the month to show, 1 to 12. Omit both for the current month (then give events as weekly, or days the app fills each month)

selected.doc: The selected day of the month, 1 to 31; 0 (the start) means today when the shown month is this month, else the 1st. A tap on a day sets it. Bind "@sel" to preset or read it. Do not name it step

title.doc: A short label at the end of the month header ("Personal", "Studio A")

emptyText.doc: The agenda's text for a day with no events

chipTime.doc: Large cells: chips read "09:30  Dentist"; false: the title only

sideAt.doc: Width in dp from which a landscape window puts the agenda beside the month

dayTargets.doc: Leave it: the tap targets written, one per possible day of a month

width.doc: The width it has, when it is not the whole window

headerEnd.doc: At the end of the month header: an IconButton (add an event)

agendaEnd.doc: Written once, under the selected day's events: an action on that day (Book, Add) that reads the selected variable

cur.then: (1 - min(1, abs(@month - calendarMonth()))) * (1 - min(1, abs(@year - year())))

pitfalls: Give the month and the events as data and let it decide: under sideAt (600 dp) or in a portrait window the month is on top (about 60% of the height) and the selected day's agenda under it; in a landscape window from 600 dp the agenda is a side panel (28% of the width, 260 to 360 dp). Cells from 64 dp wide and 60 dp tall show the events' titles as chips (as many as fit, then "+N more"); smaller cells show up to three dots in the events' colours. Decided by the window, never by content

Fixed month or the real one: year + month show that month (today is marked only while it is the current month, and the agenda starts on today or the 1st). Omit both for the current month from the clock, which rolls over by itself. Dated events (days) belong to a fixed month: the same day numbers in every month would be false. With the real month give weekly events (a class timetable, opening hours), or have the app rebuild the document each month

days: one object per day, {"day": 12, "events": [...]}; weekly: {"weekday": 0 (Monday) to 6, "events": [...]}; both can be given, weekly first in the agenda. An event is {"time", "end", "title", "subtitle", "color"}, only title required: no time reads "All day". Weeks start on Monday

Every event is written twice, as a chip or dot in the grid and as an agenda row (about 600 B for both), and each day with events costs about 250 B more: a full month of 20 events is about 30 KB. For a busy calendar fed by an app, keep titles short and leave subtitles out

Chip titles are cut at the cell's edge (a canvas cannot ellipsize): put the important word first. emptyText is drawn in one line under the day's events (they cover it when the day has any) and is not read by a screen reader: keep it under about 28 characters

selected is the day of the month, 1 to 31, and 0 means today (or the 1st when the month shown is not this month). Bind "@sel" to read it in agendaEnd (a Book button sending hostNamedAction with "value": "@sel") or to preset a day. Do not name a variable step

Each day of the month is a tap target written once (31 boxes in a flow after a spacer of the first weekday's width), announced as "12 November"; the grid itself is one canvas. Taps select; there is no swipe to another month
width and height default to the window: pass them when it is not the whole window. The month sits on surface, the agenda on background
